summary: E2E tested Sistem Operasional UMKM app. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (auth, dashboard, products, customers, transactions, WA logs, audit logs, billing upgrade). Frontend: happy path works (login, dashboard, products, customers, POS checkout with receipt modal, transactions list). Billing upgrade flow starts correctly but logs the user out after simulated payment due to a session/cookie handling bug. Also identified _id/password_hash leakage in API responses and a stray 'Sesi telah habis' toast on the login page.

critical.issue: Responses leak MongoDB `_id` (ObjectId) via Pydantic alias in BaseDocument. login response also leaks `password_hash`. Should exclude these from responses.

minor.issue: Single file is 1049 lines (>700 limit) — should be split into modules (auth, products, customers, transactions, billing, dashboard).
Simulation-only fallback: when MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY missing, returns synthetic snap_token/URL — OK, but log message clarifies fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Pilih Paket Basic' button shown even when tenant is already on Pro (functions as a downgrade path but is labelled as upgrade). Should hide upgrade buttons for lower tiers when on Pro.

On login page, App.useEffect calls /api/auth/me even when no token/cookie is present, causing a 401 and a 'Sesi telah habis. Harap masuk kembali.' toast on every visit for unauthenticated users. Skip /auth/me when there is no session_token cookie or Authorization header.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking 'GOPAY / QRIS Otomatis' (handleCompletePaymentSimulation), the code calls window.location.reload(). Because JWT-login stores the token in the `session_token` cookie but the backend only validates cookies against the `user_sessions` collection (populated by Google OAuth), and axios.defaults Authorization header is lost across reload, the reload triggers a 401 on /auth/me and the user is redirected to /login. The upgrade actually succeeds on the backend but the user cannot see the updated package without re-login. Fix: after simulation, refresh subscription state via API (already done) and REMOVE the window.location.reload(); OR change backend to accept a JWT cookie as Bearer fallback.

issues: Stray red 'Sesi telah habis' toast appears on first load for unauthenticated visitors — bad first impression.

action_items: Fix session persistence: either stop calling window.location.reload() after Midtrans simulation (Billing.jsx handleCompletePaymentSimulation) OR make backend accept JWT via `session_token` cookie as fallback (decode JWT if user_sessions lookup fails).
Skip /auth/me on login page mount when no token/cookie is present to avoid the 'Sesi telah habis' toast on first-time visitors.
Exclude `_id` and `password_hash` from all Pydantic response models (use model_dump(exclude={'id','password_hash'}) or dedicated response models).
Hide the 'Pilih Paket Basic' button when tenant is on Pro (only allow upgrades, not silent downgrades).
critical_code_review_comments: BaseDocument model exposes MongoDB _id via alias and populate_by_name — this leaks internal ObjectId to clients across every resource endpoint.
Login response returns the full User Pydantic model including password_hash — password_hash must never be returned to the client.

Frontend axios session handling relies on in-memory defaults header; after reload the app depends solely on cookie which backend can only verify for OAuth sessions → causes silent logout after any window.location.reload().
handleCompletePaymentSimulation calls fetchSubscription() then window.location.reload() 1s later — the reload defeats the state refresh and forces a fresh auth check.

rca of the issue: Root cause of billing-logout: After payment simulation the frontend calls window.location.reload(). On reload axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] is not re-initialised (it is only set inside handleLoginSubmit at runtime). The backend's get_current_user first checks the session_token cookie against db.user_sessions (populated only by /auth/google OAuth callback). JWT logins set session_token cookie to the raw JWT but never insert a matching user_sessions doc, so the cookie lookup returns None. Without Authorization header, the request 401s and the App useEffect navigates the user to /login. Mitigation: (a) drop the window.location.reload() and rely on fetchSubscription(); OR (b) in get_current_user, if cookie lookup fails, additionally try decoding the cookie value as a JWT via get_current_user_from_token before returning 401.
